About us
Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role
Thousands of rental companies run their business on Rentman, and many of them depend on it talking smoothly to the rest of their stack: accounting packages, webshops, calendars, and our public API. When an integration breaks, invoices don’t sync, bookings go missing, and customers notice fast.
As Senior QA Specialist for the Integrations team, you make sure every release reaches those customers without regressions. You own the team’s test strategy and lead the move from manual release-day testing to an automated, shift-left suite. This is a role with real ownership: you shape how the team thinks about quality, and you grow the practice as our integrations platform grows.

What you'll do
Join refinement with the Integrations team and write Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance specs that developers turn into tests
Test new integrations and API changes end to end: our side, the partner’s side, and everything that can go wrong between them (auth, rate limits, partial syncs, retries, data mapping)
Explore beyond the acceptance criteria to find edge cases, and file clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira
Build and maintain automated tests in TypeScript, with API and contract tests alongside Playwright E2E tests, and review the tests developers write in pull requests
Own the daily automated regression run in GitHub Actions: triage failures the same day and fix flaky tests at the root cause, including ones caused by unreliable third-party sandboxes
Run release-day regression and the OWASP ZAP security scan, and give a clear go / no-go call
Migrate the remaining legacy tests and decide what’s worth automating and what stays manual
Coach developers so they own their tests, and organise QA days with the other product teams

What we are looking for
5+ years in QA on web applications
Hands-on experience testing REST APIs and integrations with external systems (Postman, Playwright API testing or similar), including authentication flows like OAuth and webhooks
At least 2 years writing and maintaining test automation in code (Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, ideally TypeScript/JavaScript), not only record-and-play tools
Strong exploratory testing skills, with bug reports developers can act on without follow-up questions
You’ve defined a test strategy (what to automate, what to test manually, coverage), not only executed test cases
Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions or similar)
You get developers to adopt new habits through pairing, good examples and clear specs, not by policing

Nice to haves
Experience with complex B2B SaaS, ideally with a public API or integration marketplace
Contract testing (e.g. Pact) or mocking third-party services
Playwright specifically, and Gherkin / BDD
Experience leading a shift-left change
Testing integrations with accounting or finance software
Basic security testing (e.g. OWASP ZAP)

What you’ll get
Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance
A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)
25 vacation days to recharge
Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years.

Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac
Stay active with the team: join the Rentman football team, squash and padel, plus a discounted Urban Sports membership
An OV Business card if you live more than 10km from the office
An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team
A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities
An amazing office in the heart of Utrecht, in the historic Drift 17

Job Description

At Lely, software plays a crucial role in the performance, reliability, and safety of our robotic and farm management solutions. Every day, our products help dairy farmers around the world work more efficiently while improving animal welfare and supporting sustainable food production.

As a Senior Test Automation Engineer, you help shape the quality engineering and test automation strategy for Horizon, Lely's farm management platform. You provide technical direction, drive improvements across multiple teams, and help elevate the maturity of our testing practices. Your focus goes beyond building and maintaining automated tests; you create the conditions that enable teams to deliver high-quality software with confidence.

You take ownership of strategic quality initiatives, identify opportunities for improvement, and help teams make informed decisions based on objective quality data. You play a leading role in advancing our automation approach across multiple test levels, including component, API, and end-to-end testing. This includes further developing our component testing capabilities, designing, implementing, and maintaining the underlying test infrastructure, such as CI/CD test pipelines, test execution environments, and CI/CD runners. You drive continuous improvements to the test platform, ensuring fast, reliable feedback throughout the software delivery lifecycle and enabling teams to deliver high-quality software with confidence.

As a senior member of the Test Automation Chapter, you help define standards, share best practices, coach fellow engineers, and contribute to the long-term direction of test automation within Digital Farming. Many improvements extend beyond a single development team, requiring you to build alignment and collaborate effectively with stakeholders and engineering teams in the Netherlands, Turkey and Portugal.

Alongside these chapter-wide responsibilities, you are also part of a Scrum team, where you contribute hands-on to the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated tests and quality practices within Horizon.

The work is carried out primarily from our campus in Maassluis. Occasional travel to Turkey is expected to support collaboration and successful implementation of improvements across teams.

Your main responsibilities include:

Defining and evolving the test automation strategy across component, API, and end-to-end testing. 
Leading quality improvement initiatives and driving adoption across multiple teams. 
Providing technical direction and coaching to fellow test automation engineers within the Test Automation Chapter. 
Taking ownership of the component testing domain, including defining the approach, expanding component test coverage, and integrating it into the CI/CD pipeline. 
Driving collaboration between testing, software development, architecture, and other technical disciplines across the Netherlands and Turkey. 
Providing objective insights on product quality, risk, and release readiness.

Designing, implementing, and maintaining automated E2E and API tests using TypeScript and Playwright. 
Designing, implementing, and maintaining component tests using C# and Testcontainers. 
Supporting the migration from Cucumber to Playwright. 
Managing and improving CI/CD test pipelines in GitLab. 
Owning the automated quality gates that determine merge readiness. 
Managing the Windows VM test lab and associated infrastructure. 
Maintaining dashboards, reporting pipelines, and quality metrics. 
Maintaining the supporting tooling and scripts used for test execution and infrastructure automation in PowerShell, Python, Azure, Windows, and Kubernetes environments. 

Qualifications

You are a people-oriented senior engineer with a strong technical foundation and a passion for product quality. You enjoy helping engineers grow, bringing teams together, and creating clarity in complex development environments.

AT least 5 years of experience in test automation, verification, or quality engineering within a technical product development environment. 
Experience guiding, coaching, or mentoring engineers in technical initiatives.

About Harver

Harver delivers a suite of automated solutions that optimize talent decisions for some of the world's leading organizations. Rooted in over 40 years of science and rich data insights backed by industrial-organizational and cognitive science, we enable organizations to engage, hire, and grow the right talent in a fast and fundamentally unbiased way.

Our Employee Value Proposition

Putting the right person in the right role is life-changing — for the individual and for the organization. That's not a tagline. It's the reason we come to work. We've applied 35 years of assessment science to one of the hardest problems in business, helping thousands of organizations hire with more confidence and less guesswork. Now we're entering our most exciting chapter yet — new products, a sharpened focus, and a market that genuinely needs what we've built.

The people here are something else. Smart, authentic, genuinely invested in the work and in each other. This isn't a place where you coast — you'll be pushed and expected to deliver. But you'll do it alongside people who care, led by a vision that's worth working hard for.

If that sounds like your kind of place, we'd love to meet you.

Job Overview

Everything Harver builds exists to help our customers achieve a greater Return on Talent Investment — putting the right person in the right role through science-backed, skills-based hiring. That promise only holds if the platforms behind it are dependable, and that's the quality bar you'll own. As our QA Manager, you'll be the most senior quality voice at Harver, accountable for the quality of every platform we support and for the QA Engineers who protect each one.

This is a builder's role, not a gatekeeper's. You'll set the quality strategy across our platforms, shape how quality is designed into products from discovery onward, and lead a team of platform-focused QA Engineers — coaching them, setting direction, and raising the ceiling on what good looks like. You'll be as comfortable authoring acceptance criteria and reviewing test architecture as you are running a 1:1 or making the call on an escalation. You know automation deeply (Playwright, Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, Postgres) and are fluent with AI-assisted engineering — Claude Code, agents, and skills — and you use that fluency to build systems and standards that scale, not to become the bottleneck.

If you're passionate about working in a dynamic, fast-growing company — with cutting edge technology, smart colleagues, and opportunities for development — come grow with us!

Responsibilities And Qualifications

In this role you get to:

Own quality across every platform Harver supports — set the strategy, define what "healthy" looks like for each platform, and hold a continuously current view of quality and a standing plan for how to improve it. 
Lead and grow the QA function — manage the QA Engineers responsible for each platform, coach and develop them, set clear direction, and build a high-performing, high-trust team. 
Shift quality left — bring QA into discovery by default, so quality risks, edge cases, and acceptance expectations are shaped before engineering takes ownership rather than discovered late. 
Own acceptance criteria and test contracts as the backbone of quality — ensure stories reach engineering with testable criteria, risk tiers, and non-functional requirements defined up front, so engineers build against a clear contract. 
Own and evolve the test automation architecture and tooling — engineers write the tests; you own the frameworks, pattern libraries, and standards they build against, and you keep them fit for a growing platform. 
Drive production health across platforms — review production signals on a regular cadence, monitor NFR compliance, track bugs and escalations by platform and severity, and make feature health scores available and trustworthy for every new feature. 
Lead incident response from a quality lens — you hold independent authority to declare an escalation without waiting for approval, drive root-cause analysis, and close the loop by updating contracts so the same gap doesn't reappear. 
Configure and maintain AI-assisted quality pipelines across the delivery lifecycle — from solution-document and AC review through test generation, PR risk scoring, and production signal analysis. 

We're Looking For People Who Have

Proven experience managing QA Engineers — you've led a quality team, developed people, and set direction, not just delivered your own work. 
Command of our technology stack — you're comfortable and hands-on with Playwright, Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and Postgres. 
Fluency with AI-assisted engineering — you know your way around Claude Code and can set up agents and skills to compress manual effort and raise coverage. 
Deep, senior-level automation expertise — you're hands-on and credible in writing automation tests against the stack above. 
A track record of owning test architecture and contracts — acceptance criteria, risk tiers, NFRs, and the frameworks engineers build against. 
Strong production-health instincts — comfort with monitoring, signal review, incident response, and turning production patterns into better coverage. 
The judgment to know when to escalate and the confidence to make that call independently. 
A builder's mindset — you scale quality through systems, standards, and people rather than personal throughput. 
Preferred: exposure to AI-assisted quality tooling, mutation testing, and observability stacks (e.g., Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), and experience owning quality across multiple products or platforms at once.

32–40 uur · Amsterdam · Hybride · €3.800–€6.000 bruto per maand bij 40 uur

Over JW
JW is een digitaal verzekeringsbedrijf voor particulieren en ondernemers, met een sterke focus op voertuigverzekeringen. Meer dan 14.000 klanten regelen hun verzekering via JW. Technologie en automatisering vormen de basis van onze dienstverlening: van online aanvragen en polisbeheer tot klantcommunicatie en schadeafhandeling.
Binnen JW Volmacht accepteren, administreren en beheren we verzekeringen namens verzekeraars. Daardoor kunnen we meer van het proces zelf organiseren en verbeteren. We combineren bestaande platforms met eigen software en koppelingen, zodat klanten meer zelf kunnen regelen en collega’s minder handmatig werk hoeven te doen.
We groeien en zoeken iemand die onze systemen en processen helpt meegroeien.
Dit ga je doen
Je werkt voornamelijk met Novulo, ons polisadministratiesysteem. Hier richt je verzekeringsproducten, polisbladen, workflows en communicatie in. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan een losse systeemwijziging: hoe loopt het hele proces, welke informatie is nodig en wat kan eenvoudiger?
Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:
Novulo configureren, beheren en verbeteren.
Nieuwe verzekeringsproducten inrichten en bestaande producten onderhouden.
Wensen van collega’s onderzoeken en vertalen naar functionele eisen en systeemoplossingen.
Knelpunten in processen herkennen en verbeteringen realiseren.
Nieuwe functionaliteiten, producten en releases testen.
Met developers samenwerken aan wijzigingen en koppelingen tussen systemen.
Collega’s informeren over veranderingen en belangrijke procesafspraken vastleggen.
Een van je eerste projecten is het helpen opzetten en automatiseren van schadeflows: van schademelding tot uitbetaling. Daarnaast werk je aan nieuwe producten en verbeteringen in de bestaande polisadministratie.
Met wie werk je samen?
Je komt terecht in een klein team met korte lijnen. Je werkt samen met onze business consultant, developers en collega’s die betrokken zijn bij acceptatie, schadebehandeling, finance en compliance. Je leidinggevende is de technisch verantwoordelijke.

Dit neem je mee
Je hebt relevante werkervaring met functioneel beheer, applicatie-inrichting, procesverbetering of de functionele kant van softwareprojecten. Je kunt werkzaamheden zelfstandig oppakken en zoekt actief naar manieren om processen beter te laten werken.
Daarnaast:
Beschik je over HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau.
Kun je gebruikerswensen analyseren en vertalen naar concrete oplossingen.
Werk je zorgvuldig en test je wijzigingen voordat ze in gebruik worden genomen.
Heb je voldoende technisch inzicht om met developers samen te werken.
Kun je jouw ideeën en bevindingen duidelijk uitleggen aan collega’s.
Toon je initiatief, denk je mee en vraag je tijdig hulp wanneer dat nodig is.
Een opleiding zoals Business IT & Management, Technische Bedrijfskunde, Informatica of Bedrijfskunde sluit goed aan, maar is geen vereiste.
Ervaring met Novulo is niet nodig. We helpen je het platform te leren kennen. Ook verzekeringskennis kun je bij JW opbouwen.

Je krijgt ruimte om verbeteringen zelf te onderzoeken en uit te werken. Je werkt direct samen met ervaren collega’s en de oprichters, zonder veel managementlagen of lange besluitvorming.

Een salaris van €3.800–€6.00 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van je ervaring en de verantwoordelijkheid die je kunt dragen, exclusief vakantiegeld.
Een functie voor 32–40 uur per week.

Een werkplek in Amsterdam, momenteel bij Spaces Westerpark.
De mogelijkheid om in overleg gedeeltelijk thuis te werken.
Begeleiding, coaching en ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.
Een laptop, telefoon en reiskostenvergoeding.
Een informele werksfeer met veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid.

We beginnen met een online kennismaking met de recruiter. We bespreken je ervaring, motivatie en verwachtingen. Jij leert JW en de functie beter kennen en kunt je vragen stellen.
Daarna volgt een verdiepend gesprek bij ons op kantoor met de technisch verantwoordelijke. We gaan verder in op je kennis en vaardigheden, bespreken de werkzaamheden en onderzoeken of er een wederzijdse klik is met het team.

Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan ontvang je een arbeidsvoorwaardenvoorstel. Een VOG voor financiële dienstverlening maakt onderdeel uit van de screening.

Solliciteer via het formulier op onze website of stuur je cv en een korte motivatie naar werkenbij@jw.nl. We doen ons best om binnen een week op je sollicitatie te reageren.
